name: lesson-service
description: A lesson composed from real SmartCiti.X Holodeck stations for a sentence, such as a lockout refresher for apprentices: stations in order with the reason for each, the unions and standards they name, and a pass bar. Union-trade audiences today; K-12 programmes as they land in the registry. Not a certification.
